prompt: Lead two reviewer-owned unfamiliar engineering-organization scenarios with materially different urgency, authority and team topology. After the first defense, the reviewer changes at least one outcome or risk assumption, one decision-rights or stakeholder constraint, and one capacity, psychological-safety or incident condition. Produce independent evidence without model answers, employer-confidential material, employee evaluation, external messages or production authority.
deliverables: Outcome map connecting customer operation, service health, delivery, risk, capability and learning
Evidence ledger separating observations, calculations, estimates, preferences, decisions and unknowns
Authority map for technical lead, manager, product, security, legal, incident and execution roles
Decision-rights table with one accountable owner, consultation, explicit veto, deadline, reversibility and escalation
Capacity plan showing available, committed, reserve, requested, selected, deferred and stopped work
Prioritization memo with outcome, risk, cost-of-delay, dependency, effort-confidence and trade-off reasoning
Delegation contracts with outcome, boundary, authority, information, resources, checkback and escalation
Stakeholder map and at least three audience-fit views derived from one canonical fact set
Psychological-safety and accountability mechanisms for questions, dissent, mistakes, standards and repair
Behavior-specific feedback plan and mentoring plan with scaffolding, practice and transfer evidence
Asynchronous decision record, one purpose-bound meeting design and acknowledged handoff
Incident leadership plan covering command, operations, communication, mutation control, fatigue and relief
Ethics and confidentiality review including conflicts of interest and authority limits
Effectiveness review with outcome, decision-flow, load, learning and risk measures
Truthful STAR-L interview narrative using only evidence generated in the exercise and naming limitations
Revised operating system showing how hidden changes alter or preserve earlier decisions
evidenceRequirements: Use reviewer-owned fictional or sanitized disposable organizational data only
No employer strategy, employee record, performance rating, customer data, private message, credential, production endpoint or confidential incident
Every material claim records identity, class, source, window, unit where applicable, confidence and owner
Role titles are not treated as implicit authority; every consequential decision has a declared boundary
Capacity arithmetic conserves and stopped work is explicit
Priority is an ordering decision and not a label applied to every request
Delegated responsibility is matched by decision rights, information, resources, checkback and escalation
Dissent and unknowns are preserved; consensus is not falsely reported as unanimity
Feedback addresses observable behavior and impact rather than personality or protected characteristics
Mentoring demonstrates growing independent judgment rather than mentor takeover
Stakeholder views preserve canonical facts and apply confidentiality boundaries
Incident authority prevents freelance mutation and fatigue has an explicit relief path
Actions close on measured effectiveness rather than document, meeting or training completion
Career examples contain no fabricated metric, title, authority, outcome or team judgment
Reviewer controls hidden changes, scoring, challenge questions, follow-up observation and cleanup proof

rubric.observableEvidence: Outcomes, facts, estimates, decisions, unknowns, sources and confidence remain distinguishable
Decision ownership, consultation, veto, reversibility, deadline and escalation match actual authority
Capacity conserves and selected, reserved, deferred and stopped work have evidence-based trade-offs
Authority and support match responsibility while checkbacks build independent judgment
Questions and dissent are safe while behavior, standards, repair and support stay explicit
Audience decisions, objections, confidentiality and canonical facts guide communication without invented authority
Async records, meetings, handoffs, incident roles, mutation control and fatigue relief produce closed loops
Harm, conflicts, privacy, authority and interview evidence are handled without fabrication or concealment
Outcome, flow, load, repeat-failure and action-effectiveness evidence changes the system
Hidden outcome, authority and team-condition changes produce justified revisions without answer leakage
